Theorem
[Bochner vanishing for harmonic $1$-forms]

Source: petersen:page-0352 ↗ prop:pet-ch9-bochner-formula-1forms 1. ch9:9.2.3Every harmonic one-form on a compact Riemannian manifold with $\operatorname {Ric}\ge 0$ is parallel.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch9-bochner-vanishing-1forms \sketch For the dual field $X$, harmonicity and item 2 give

\[ \Delta \tfrac 12|X|^2=|\nabla X|^2+\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)\ge 0. \]

Compactness and the maximum principle make $|X|$ constant; both nonnegative terms therefore vanish, so $X$ and its dual form are parallel.

□
